records.text: Richard William Erpenbeck reportedly prepared but did not record a deed transferring property to Anita Andrews; she had not signed it, and he then transferred the property to his parents.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Cool. Thirdly, Rick (Richard William Erpenbeck) prepared a deed transferring property to a woman named Anita Andrews, but apparently he did not record that deed with the county and the deed wasn't actually signed by Anita Andrews. ... That's weird. And he then quickly transferred that same property to his mother and father. So this kind of feels like this is deed fraud.

verification.notes: The Kentucky Supreme Court opinion states Erpenbeck prepared a deed to Anita, failed to ensure it was signed and recorded, and later prepared a deed transferring the same property to his parents.

sources.title: Richard Erpenbeck v. Kentucky Bar Association
sources.relevance: Kentucky Supreme Court opinion confirms the unsigned/unrecorded deed and later transfer to the parents.
